about.title: Ho asɛm
about.intro: {project} yɛ awo ntoatoaso foforo peer-to-peer faele kyɛ platform a wɔde nnɛ mmere mu mfiridwuma a ɛnam mfinimfini ano abesi. Ɛkeka di a ɛyɛ mmerɛw user interface ne arkitɛkture a ɛnam mfinimfini, ɛma sekuw ne nokware nyiyiɛm a ɛkyerɛ data kyɛ a ennyɛ adwuma wɔ mfinimfini tumi biara so. Adwuma yi yɛ open source na wɔkyɛ wɔ {license} ase.

decentralized.title: Atumitumi network a ɛnam mfinimfini koraa
decentralized.description: Mfinimfini server biara nni hɔ, beae biako a ebetumi adi nkogu nni hɔ. Adwumayɛfo hwehwɛ na wɔtwe twe nneɛma tee wɔn ntam, a wɔnnyɛ adwuma wɔ mfinimfini indexer, tracker anaa database biara so.

accessControl.title: Nsam-keka kɔketere
accessControl.description: Obiara wɔ ahofadi sɛ ɔde n'ankasa mmara befi n'ankasa network ase. Hyehyɛ adwumayɛfo dwumadie wɔ network biara mu: oyɛ, admin, kasamafo, moderator ne twe twefo. Hwɛ kɔketere obi a obetumi atintim, moderator ne twe twe nneɛma.

ui.title: Adwumayɛfo interface a ɛkorɔn
ui.description: Media center interface a ɛyɛ kronkron na ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔde adwumayɛfo ano abesi ma desktop, TV ne mobile platforms. Nantew a ɛnyɛ den wɔ keyboard, mouse, gamepad anaa remote control so. Adwumayɛfo a wɔakɔ akyiri betumi de command line interface adi dwuma de software ayɛ headless faele server.

dataFormat.title: Onipa tumi kenkan data format
dataFormat.description: LISH data format gyina JSON so, na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛyɛ, akenkan na wɔate ase. Kyɛ wo nneɛma ne metadata pefee, ɛyɛ pue a obiara betumi ahwɛ mu mmerɛw.

security.title: Kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ
security.description: Peer-to-peer nkitahodi nyinaa yɛ encrypted, na ɛma wo data kɔ so yɛ kokoamsɛm wɔ transmission mu. Adwumayɛfo betumi ahintaw VPN akyi de aka anonymity layer foforo. {project} bu wo kokoamsɛm wɔ design mu.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software wɔ hɔ ma Windows, Linux ne macOS platforms. Fa di dwuma wɔ device biara a wopɛ so.

download.title: Twe twe
download.description: Nya {project} ma wo platform. Twe twe nyinaa yɛ ɔkwan na ɛyɛ open source.
